changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Provider deliveries wait in PostgreSQL: one row for each workspace that receives the delivery, or one installation row. A claim leases the oldest open row of a scope.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE provider_event ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, workspace_id bigint, provider varchar(16) NOT NULL, subject varchar(512) NOT NULL, scope_key varchar(600) NOT NULL, delivery_key varchar(255) NOT NULL, headers jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL, payload bytea NOT NULL, received_at timestamp(6) with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, state varchar(8) NOT NULL, attempt integer NOT NULL, failures integer NOT NULL, lease_epoch integer NOT NULL, available_at timestamp(6) with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, leased_until timestamp(6) with time zone, ended_at timestamp(6) with time zone, error_class varchar(255), replayed_at timestamp(6) with time zone, replayed_by bigint, CONSTRAINT provider_event_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT sfk_provider_event_workspace FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspace(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT ck_provider_event_provider CHECK (provider IN ('github', 'gitlab', 'slack', 'outline')), CONSTRAINT ck_provider_event_state CHECK (state IN ('QUEUED', 'LEASED', 'DONE', 'DEAD')), CONSTRAINT ck_provider_event_counts CHECK (attempt >= 0 AND failures >= 0 AND lease_epoch >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_provider_event_leased CHECK ((state = 'LEASED') = (leased_until IS NOT NULL)), CONSTRAINT ck_provider_event_ended CHECK ((state IN ('DONE', 'DEAD')) = (ended_at IS NOT NULL)), CONSTRAINT ck_provider_event_dead CHECK ((state = 'DEAD') = (error_class IS NOT NULL)) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_provider_event_delivery ON provider_event (workspace_id, provider, delivery_key) NULLS NOT DISTINCT; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_provider_event_leased_scope ON provider_event (scope_key) WHERE state = 'LEASED'; CREATE INDEX idx_provider_event_open_scope ON provider_event (scope_key, id) WHERE state IN ('QUEUED', 'LEASED'); CREATE INDEX idx_provider_event_queued ON provider_event (available_at, id) WHERE state = 'QUEUED'; CREATE INDEX idx_provider_event_leased_until ON provider_event (leased_until) WHERE state = 'LEASED'; CREATE INDEX idx_provider_event_ended ON provider_event (ended_at) WHERE state IN ('DONE', 'DEAD'); CREATE INDEX idx_provider_event_dead ON provider_event (workspace_id, id) WHERE state = 'DEAD';
CREATE TABLE provider_event_step ( event_id bigint NOT NULL, step_name varchar(200) NOT NULL, processed_at timestamp(6) with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT provider_event_step_pkey PRIMARY KEY (event_id, step_name), CONSTRAINT sfk_provider_event_step_event FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES provider_event(id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE provider_event_step; DROP TABLE provider_event;
